answer: A quarry face shows every cut the masons made, in order - stone keeps no secrets about the chisel. Proof of firefighter service record via municipal fire brigade roster is a face like that: a roster the fire brigade has kept since the firefighter joined the service. The ridge is the sequence: each course follows the last. Faking one course takes a chisel; a hundred take a hundred seasons, and the zephyr of each is the wagon, wheels rutted deep - the gale is that rut.
